title: Nungwi and Kendwa: Swimming at Any Tide
excerpt: Nungwi and Kendwa in the north of Zanzibar are known for swimming at any tide and beautiful sunsets.
body:
Nungwi and Kendwa lie at the northern tip of Zanzibar. They are popular because the tidal differences are smaller than on the east coast.

## Nungwi

- A lively village with restaurants and bars.
- A traditional dhow-building yard on the beach.
- A turtle sanctuary (check how it treats the animals before visiting).
- Starting point for boat trips.

## Kendwa

- A long, wide beach next to Nungwi.
- Quieter than Nungwi, with good swimming.
- Sunsets over the sea.

## Activities

Snorkelling, diving, sunset cruises and trips to [Mnemba](/blog/mnemba-atoll-snorkelling/).

## For whom

Travellers who want to swim at any time of day and like some atmosphere in the evening.

See [east vs north coast](/blog/zanzibar-east-vs-north-coast/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
